scope: Repository-local Claude and Codex hook configuration, the shared dispatch and ingestion hook implementations, the orchestration bridge, workflow-turn bindings, existing execution receipts, and focused isolated lifecycle tests.
excluded_scope: Fresh live-host smoke, child-agent launch, network access, administrator policy installation, provider-internal inputs, browser behavior, and product-code or documentation fixes.
executive_answer: No. The governed route is implemented and tested when trusted project hooks load and the host emits a recognized PreToolUse event, but that condition is not obligatory. A fresh trusted Codex session using embedded codex-cli 0.146.0-alpha.3.1 created a child without any hook event or durable lifecycle receipt, so adoption is operationally failed for that observed binary. Adoption under the installed replacement binary is unknown pending reload and smoke. Claude has no model-originated live adoption evidence. Prelaunch is fail-closed only inside the loaded and invoked hook boundary; closure and post-tool ingestion are not globally fail-closed.
property_served: No meaningful work outside reconstructible memory.
